doc.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

title: Marian and Jimmy McPartland at Jump Town
summary: Marian McPartland told them the night before that she and Jimmy came to Jump Town after sets at the Brass Rail.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: I just remembered that last night, Marian McPartland took us, we were sitting backstage talking, and she took us back to Jump Town, where met and started playing. She said that she and Jimmy McPartland were playing in Chicago.
At the Brass Rail, and they would rush out after their final set to hear us at Jump Town, night after night after night. And we never knew it.
We never knew it. Yeah that was funny.
And just last night she related that.
Because I did know that they used to come and hear us when we were playing somewhere downtown too, and that was later, with Ventura.
But I didn’t know that they had come to the other place.
